requirement:
Marks an agent request that has begun collecting node contents. Further node inputs can be added before awaiting the answer.

```rust,ignore
pub struct NodePhase;
```
rationale:
`requirements.sdk.graph.agent-calls.NodePhase` has two obligations. A request that has started collecting node contents is marked with `NodePhase`, and more node inputs can be added before the answer is awaited. The text also declares `pub struct NodePhase;`. I did not read the implementation, because the tests answer these questions.

- **Further node inputs before awaiting:** `crates/trust-but-verify/src/graph/validation_tests.rs#fn[explicit_insertions_preserve_order_repetition_and_selection_snapshots]` chains `contents_of_current_node()`, `contents_of_successors(7)` and `contents_of_current_node()` before `into_future()`. It asserts that the agent request inputs and the graph read order contain all five contents in insertion order. It also asserts the recorded dependencies. Later node inputs were therefore accepted after collection had begun, and the repeats and the successor selection were kept.
- **The `NodePhase` state itself:** `validation_tests.rs#fn[task_messages_share_a_prefix_and_can_queue_another_node]` annotates the value returned by `contents_of_node(selected)` as `crate::request::Ask<'_, '_, Memory, Answer, crate::request::NodePhase>`. That checks the phase type after node collection begins. It then awaits the request through `message(task)` and asserts that the prefix, fingerprint and node input `(2, "selected source")` are in the request. It also asserts the dependency on `selected`.
- **Public struct:** `crates/trust-but-verify/tests/public_api.rs#fn[public_exports_match_the_appendix]` compares the rustdoc inventory with the specified exports. That covers the declared public `NodePhase` type. The type is a unit struct with no behavior of its own.

I found no input class, boundary or condition combination that the text distinguishes and the tests miss. The tests are marked `{test}` for the subject.
